column1: # Measured impact of the encode_partition_topdown HORZ/VERT fix (zenrav1e@665e58e4, pushed to
# master, unreleased; companion ravif@b4853c68). See docs/RD_GAP_VS_LIBAOM.md "Fixed 2026-07-01"
# for the full root-cause writeup (encode_partition_topdown hardcoded its RDO candidate list to
# [PARTITION_SPLIT, PARTITION_NONE] -- PARTITION_HORZ/VERT were never offered at any speed, on any
# block, ever; this is the only partition-search path cavif/zenavif use since encode_bottomup is
# forced off by ravif's SpeedTweaks).
# Harness: scripts/rd_gap/run_gap.sh, zenrav1e-only (AOMENC unset), cavif -s2, 22-image photo
# corpus (clean-picker-corpus-2026-06-26, same as the other 2026-07-01 ablations), 12-point Q
# grid. "unfixed" = pre-fix zenrav1e via git-reverted encoder.rs + rebuild; "fixed" = the pushed
# commit. Both runs used the IDENTICAL corpus/settings/day. Raw per-image data (gitignored,
# regenerable): scripts/rd_gap/rd_gap_{fixed,unfixed}_results.tsv.
# NOTE: this is a NARROWER methodology than the 2026-06-30 canonical baseline (single cavif
# config/format here, vs that baseline's best-of-{speed x format x bit-depth} frontier) -- the
# absolute numbers below are not directly comparable to the +16.3/11.8/7.8/18.5% headline. The
# before/after DELTA under this identical methodology is the valid signal.
# Direct fixed-vs-unfixed (isolates the fix; no libaom involved), bpp change at matched ssim2,
# + = fixed needs MORE bits (worse), - = fixed needs FEWER bits (better):
